metadata.title: doit — Your personal workout app
metadata.description: 800+ illustrated exercises, strength and cardio routines, no ads and no sign-up.

hero.title: Train without distractions
hero.description: No auto-recommendations, no feed, no notifications you never asked for. You build the routine and doit helps you complete it.

showcase.imageAlt: doit screens showing workouts, progress, muscles and reminders

features.title: What you need to keep progressing.
features.description: Find the right exercise, build a routine around your goals, and stay focused through every set.

cards.title: Explore
cards.body: Find the right exercise from more than 800 illustrated movements organized by muscle group.

cards.title: Build
cards.body: Create strength and cardio routines that fit your goals, schedule, and available equipment.

cards.title: Train
cards.body: Follow every exercise, set, and repetition in a simple experience that keeps you moving.

insights.title: See your progress at a glance.
insights.description: Turn every session into clear charts and detailed reports. See your exercises, sets, reps, and training history in one visual summary.
insights.imageAlt: Workout charts and detailed training reports in doit

share.title: Train. Share it. Feel proud.
share.description: Turn every workout into a visual summary you can save and share — from the first set to the last rep.

privacy.title: Your workouts stay yours.
privacy.description: No account, no cloud, and no tracking. Your routines and training history stay securely on your device, always under your control.

cta.title: All set. All that's left is to start.
cta.description: Choose your exercises, build a routine around your goals, and start training. doit keeps it simple.

metadata.title: Join the closed beta — doit
metadata.description: Join the doit closed beta and help us bring a private, distraction-free workout app to Google Play.

beta.title: Help doit reach Google Play.
beta.description: Be part of the first group of testers, try the app before launch, and help us improve.
benefits: A direct way to share feedback
Your email used only for beta access

form.title: Save your spot.
form.description: Use the same Google Account email you have in the Play Store.
form.consent: I agree that doit may use this email only to manage my closed beta invitation.
form.status: We will send a secure link to confirm that the email belongs to you before adding it to the list.
form.success: Check your inbox. If the address can receive invitations, you will find a confirmation link valid for 30 minutes.
form.error: We could not complete registration right now. Refresh the security check and try again.
form.verified: Your email is confirmed. You are now on the closed beta waitlist.
form.verificationInvalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
form.verificationInvalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Submit your email again to receive a new one.

beta.privacyNote: No spam and no marketing lists. You can request removal of your email at any time.
